audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is exactly right: Yorick wins 47.23% of 1749 games and the page handed him six of seven stages, with whys[] opening 'You win level 1... You win level 2... You win level 6...'.
audit.why: The audited mirror sets Skill / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Yorick — a losing lane that turns over only at two items. Five rows disagreed between the two sides.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings inverse to the mirror, and every why rewritten to argue for the side it now sits on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike named Divine Sunderer and Stridebreaker as your spike and claimed Shen 'can't out-DPS a full Maiden pile'. The second packet defect is also real: zero cooldown-sequencing lines anywhere.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s, Spirit's Refuge 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Twilight Assault 8/7.25/6.5/5.75/5s, Stand United 200/180/160s. Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s. Without those numbers 'trade when it is down' is not advice.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, the level-3-5 spike, the first-item spike and dosFull[0], and the first-item claim reversed to Shen's tank item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two flat factual errors. spikes[0] and wants.foe[0] say Ki Barrier procs off his auto-attacks. Nothing on the page mentioned what Twilight Assault or Spirit's Refuge actually do.
audit.why: Riot's Ki Barrier text: 'After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield' — spell casts, not autos, and affecting champions lowers its cooldown, so it is available in essentially every trade. Twilight Assault deals damage based on the target's max health, which is why building health does not make the duel safer. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks that would hit Shen or allies near his spirit blade — an attack-block zone your entire Mist Walker pack walks into.
audit.corrected: Ki Barrier is a spell-cast shield, so it is up in every trade. Twilight Assault scales off your max health. Walk the pack out of the Spirit's Refuge zone before committing; it is 16s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Spirit's Refuge blocks Mist Walker attacks specifically, and whether Dark Procession's wall stops Shadow Dash mid-dash, are not answerable from Riot's text.
audit.why: The terrain flag supports 'blocks movement', not 'cancels a dash already in flight'. The mirror reached the same conclusion and left it alone.
